case_title: Case 1: Star Health — Lumbar Spine Discectomy Denial (Alex)
key_statute: Section 45 of Insurance Act 1938 (4-Year Incontestability Moratorium) & IRDAI Master Circular 2024
denial_raw_text:
STAR HEALTH AND ALLIED INSURANCE CO. LTD.
Ref: SHAI/PREAUTH/2026/MUM/882104 | Date of Notice: 26-Sep-2026
Claimant / Patient Name: Alex | Policy Number: P/161100/01/2026/009124
Hospital: Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital, Mumbai | Claim ID: CLM-991204-STAR
Date of Admission: 25-Sep-2026 (Emergency) | Total Estimated Claim: Rs. 1,85,000 /-
Provisional Diagnosis: Acute L4-L5 Lumbar Disc Herniation with Radiculopathy
Proposed Treatment: Microdiscectomy & Neural Decompression
Treating Spine Surgeon: Dr. Vikramaditya Rao, MS (Ortho), MCh Spine
Claim Status: REPUDIATED (Pre-Auth Voided)

OFFICIAL GROUNDS FOR CLAIM REPUDIATION (CLAUSE 4.3):
Upon forensic audit of the pre-authorization docket and treating physician consultation notes submitted by Kokilaben Hospital, our Competent Medical Panel observed that the patient has presented with lumbar spinal extrusion and disc pathology. Under Clause 4.3 (Pre-Existing Disease Exclusion) of the Star Comprehensive Insurance Policy Terms:
'All Pre-Existing Diseases (PED) and any complication arising therefrom are excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage.'
The insurer alleges that degenerative spinal disc disease is chronic in nature and has predated the policy inception, representing non-disclosure of material medical facts at the time of renewal. Consequently, the competent authority has repudiated the cashless pre-authorization request.

CLINICAL RECORDS TRANSCRIBED FROM HOSPITAL DOCKET:
Patient Alex: Presented with sudden acute onset severe radiating sciatica following gym trauma on 24-Sep-2026. Acute MRI Lumbar Spine dated 25-Sep-2026 demonstrates acute disc fragment extrusion at L4-L5 with severe canal stenosis. No past history of lumbar pathology or spinal treatment recorded in baseline OPD documentation.

case_title: Case 2: ICICI Lombard Motor — Surveyor 50% Depreciation Cut (Sam)
key_statute: Breach of Zero Depreciation Endorsement ZD-01 & Gurshinder Singh (2020) Supreme Court Ruling
denial_raw_text:
ICICI LOMBARD GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY LTD.
Survey Ref: ICICI/MOT/SURV/2026/90124 | Date of Inspection: 28-Sep-2026
Registered Insured / Claimant: Sam | Motor Policy No: 3001/2024/098124/00
Vehicle Make & Model: Hyundai Creta SX (O) Turbo (2024) | Registration Number: MH-02-EE-8821
Authorised Workshop: Modi Hyundai Workshop, Goregaon, Mumbai | Claim ID: CLM-MOT-44210
Insured Declared Value (IDV): Rs. 11,50,000 /- | Gross Workshop Estimate: Rs. 62,000 /-
Surveyor Name: Rajesh K. Trivedi (IRDAI Surveyor #44102) | Assessment Status: REVISED DEDUCTION APPLIED

SURVEYOR REPORT: ITEMIZED DEDUCTIONS IMPOSED UNDER IMT RULES:
The independent motor surveyor inspected vehicle MH-02-EE-8821 following front-end collision on Western Express Highway. While accidental damage is verified, the surveyor has imposed mandatory depreciation cuts citing Indian Motor Tariff (IMT) Section 2:
1. Front Bumper Assembly (Plastic/Polymer): Claimed Rs. 18,000 -> 50% Depreciation Deducted (-Rs. 9,000).
2. LED Projector Headlamp Units (Nylon/Acrylic): Claimed Rs. 24,000 -> 50% Depreciation Deducted (-Rs. 12,000).
3. Windshield Glass & Rubber Beading: Claimed Rs. 15,000 -> 50% Rubber Depreciation Deducted (-Rs. 7,500).
Total Surveyor Cut Imposed: Rs. 28,500 /-. Approved Settlement Amount: Rs. 33,500 /- (subject to Rs. 1,000 policy excess). Insured Sam is liable for the balance of Rs. 28,500 to the repairer.

Policy Reference: 3001/2024/098124/00 | Certificate No.: 9912048
Insured / Vehicle Owner: Sam | Policy Type: Comprehensive Own Damage + TP
Vehicle Registration No: MH-02-EE-8821 | Insured Declared Value (IDV): Rs. 11,50,000 /-
Policy Start Date: 10-Feb-2026 | Policy Expiry Date: 09-Feb-2027
Zero Depreciation Add-On (Nil-Dep): ACTIVE & PAID (Endorsement ZD-01)
Consumables Cover Rider: ACTIVE & PAID (Endorsement CC-04)
Compulsory Excess Deductible: Rs. 1,000 /- | Engine & Gearbox Protector: ACTIVE & PAID

ZERO DEPRECIATION ENDORSEMENT CLAUSE (ENDORSEMENT CODE ZD-01):
In consideration of payment of additional premium by the Insured Sam, it is hereby declared that in the event of an Own Damage claim:
'The Company shall NOT apply any depreciation under the Indian Motor Tariff (IMT) for replacement of plastic, rubber, nylon, fiberglass, or metal parts during accidental repair. Full 100% replacement value of all damaged parts shall be reimbursed without deduction.'
LEGAL STATUTE BINDING:
The surveyor's unilateral application of 50% depreciation directly breaches Endorsement ZD-01. Under Supreme Court precedent (Gurshinder Singh v. Shriram General), contractually purchased riders supersede standard tariff reductions.

case_title: Case 3: Care Health — Proportional Deduction Penalty Trap (Sia)
expected_verdict: Policy X-Ray Trap Audit & Consumer Appeal
key_statute: IRDAI Health Insurance Regulations (Transparency in Sub-limits) & Consumer Protection Act 2019
denial_raw_text:
CARE HEALTH INSURANCE LIMITED
Disbursement Ref: CARE/SETTLE/2026/77810 | Date: 22-Sep-2026
Claimant / Patient Name: Sia | Policy Number: 11098412/2025/00
Hospital: Max Super Speciality Hospital, Saket, New Delhi | Claim ID: CLM-778120-CARE
Ailment / Surgery: Acute Cholecystitis (Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy)
Room Category Chosen: Deluxe Suite Room (Rs. 8,000/day)
Gross Hospital Bill: Rs. 3,20,000 /- | Net Approved Amount: Rs. 1,40,000 /-
Room Rent Eligible Limit: Rs. 5,000/day (1% of Rs. 5L Sum Insured) | Deduction Status: PROPORTIONAL PENALTY IMPOSED

EXPLANATION OF PROPORTIONAL DEDUCTION APPLIED (CLAUSE 2.1):
The patient Sia was admitted in a Deluxe Room tariffed at Rs. 8,000/day, exceeding the contractual limit of Rs. 5,000/day (1% of Sum Insured). Under Clause 2.1 (Associated Medical Expenses Proportional Reduction):
'If the Insured occupies a room with room tariff higher than the eligible limit, all associated medical expenses (Surgeon fee, Operation Theatre, Anaesthesia, Diagnostics, and ICU) shall be reduced in the same proportion as the eligible room limit bears to the occupied room tariff (5,000 / 8,000 = 62.5% payable, 37.5% penalty).'
Total Proportional Deduction Slashed: Rs. 1,20,000 /-. In addition, mandatory 20% Co-Payment of Rs. 60,000 was deducted. Net payable: Rs. 1,40,000 /-. Balance Rs. 1,80,000 payable out-of-pocket by Sia.
policy_raw_text:
CARE SENIOR HEALTH INSURANCE — POLICY SCHEDULE
Policy Number: 11098412/2025/00 | Plan Code: CARE-SR-5L
Insured Person: Sia | Policy Number: 11098412/2025/00
Sum Insured: Rs. 5,00,000 /- | Policy Inception: 12-Jan-2024
Room Rent Capping: 1% of Sum Insured (Max Rs. 5,00,000 * 1% = Rs. 5,000/day)
Mandatory Co-Payment: 20% On Every Single Claim
Cataract Surgery Sub-Limit: Rs. 30,000 per eye | Joint Replacement Sub-Limit: Rs. 1,50,000
ICU Charge Capping: 2% of Sum Insured (Rs. 10,000/day)
Vulnerability Score (X-Ray): 42 / 100 (HIGH TRAP DENSITY)

POLICY X-RAY FORENSIC AUDIT — CONTRACTUAL TRAP IDENTIFICATION:
This contract features three severe hidden cost traps:
1. PROPORTIONAL DEDUCTION TRAP (Clause 2.1): Choosing a room even Rs. 500 above the Rs. 5,000 threshold slashes doctor fees, OT charges, and surgical fees across the entire hospital bill.
2. DUAL DEDUCTION CO-PAY (Clause 3.4): A mandatory 20% co-pay is calculated AFTER proportional deductions, multiplying out-of-pocket costs for senior citizen families.
3. HARD SUB-LIMITS (Clause 4.1): Modern surgeries (Robotic, Laser, Laparoscopy) are capped at fractional values regardless of Sum Insured.

case_title: Case 4: HDFC ERGO — Elective Cosmetic Surgery Denial (Rohan)
expected_verdict: Honesty Engine: Legitimate Repudiation (4-Step Financial Hardship Playbook)
key_statute: Standard IRDAI Exclusion List Code Excl-05 & GIPSA PPN Tariff Negotiation Guidelines
denial_raw_text:
HDFC ERGO GENERAL INSURANCE COMPANY LIMITED
Notice Ref: HDFC/REP/2026/BLR/55120 | Date: 19-Sep-2026
Claimant Name: Rohan | Policy Number: 2811/2024/991204/00
Hospital / Aesthetic Clinic: Aster CMI Hospital, Hebbal, Bangalore | Claim Reference: CLM-HDFC-99142
Requested Amount: Rs. 2,20,000 /- | Surgical Procedure: Aesthetic Rhinoplasty & Abdominal Liposuction
Admission Category: Elective Daycare / Planned Cosmetic | Clinical Indication: Cosmetic appearance enhancement
Adjudication Decision: 100% REPUDIATED (Legitimate Exclusion) | Appeal Viability: 0% (Standard Exclusion Sustained)

REASON FOR REPUDIATION (PERMANENT EXCLUSION CLAUSE 4.12):
The claims evaluation committee reviewed the surgical notes and pre-auth request submitted for Rohan. The documentation explicitly states that the procedure undertaken was an elective aesthetic rhinoplasty (nose contouring) and body contouring liposuction, with no documented traumatic nasal fracture or respiratory obstruction.
Under Clause 4.12 (Aesthetic, Cosmetic, and Plastic Surgery Exclusion) of HDFC ERGO Optima Secure:
'Expenses incurred on plastic surgery, aesthetic surgery, cosmetic treatment or any treatment which is not medically necessary to cure disease, illness, or reconstruct injury is permanently excluded.'
DECISION: The repudiation is 100% lawful, ethical, and unassailable. Overturn Honesty Engine triggers the 4-step Financial Hardship Playbook (tariff reduction, hospital negotiation, EMI options) rather than filing an unmerited appeal.
